stories.title: Panthers relieve Evero of defensive coordinator duties
stories.summary: The Carolina Panthers are moving on from defensive coordinator Ejiro Evero, the team announced Firday, with defensive line coach Todd Wash taking over on an interim basis.

stories.title: Jets defense to face RB Jeanty without Sweat, likely Bailey
stories.summary: Jets nose tackle T'Vondre Sweat has been ruled out with a knee injury, and rookie edge rusher David Bailey, unable to practice this week due to a strained groin, is listed as doubtful.

stories.title: Sources: Texas Tech using 2 QBs vs. Arizona as Castellanos gets uptick
stories.summary: QBs Thomas Castellanos and Will Hammond will both play significant snaps as No. 13 Texas Tech hosts No. 22 Arizona in a key Big 12 matchup, sources told ESPN.
